propositions: Reconcile passes with silently-failed sub-ops report success (exit 0) despite partial failures, because partial comment errors are recorded non-fatally and not counted in mutation_failures.

The RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP flag (default off) currently only gates hard-fail for total no-ops, not partial comment drops that pass through acli_subprocess._check_mutation_failure then get demoted to comment_errors.
When RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP is enabled, outcome[error] must be set when comment_errors is present so partial comment failures count toward mutation_failures and drive non-zero exit.
The silent-noop canary must be augmented to cover all sub-op types (comments and labels, not just links) to ensure total no-op detection is comprehensive.
Flag activation in reconcile-bridge.yml workflows must be sequenced after the Jira comment cleanup to prevent false failures on capped tickets still exceeding the 5000-comment limit.
